newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES END FIRMER, TRADE SLUGGISH.
newsitem.headline: TOKYO RUBBER FUTURES END FIRMER, TRADE SLUGGISH.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended slightly firmer on Friday as moderate buying interest emerged after the benchmark January managed to stay above a support of 120.0 yen in the morning session, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.1 yen to 2.2 yen per gram firmer. Benchmark January was up 1.1 yen at 122.4 yen.
"Activity was mainly dominated by position-adjustment ahead of the weekend. Interest in rubber futures remains thin," one trader said.
Traders said rubber prices were likely to drift sideways in lethargic summer trading.
